trigger: Behavior, bug, refactor, tests, or non-trivial verification are in scope.
exitSignal: Acceptance evidence is fresh and test sensitivity is known.
evidence: Fresh command or CI results are tied to the current implementation revision and cover the relevant acceptance criteria.
When a PRD is selected, acceptance evidence is traceable to every approved AC identifier.
Bug regression sensitivity is demonstrated, or a technical limitation and credible alternative evidence are explicit.
